query: interfaces in src that a For each synchronized detection and depth pair, send through stage 2 only the pallet select_detection already chooses, and mark every other candidate deferred by publishing its source index on the pose diagnostics together with that pair's RGB and depth capture stamps. The handling process can then tell which pallets in the still-changing scene were detected but not posed. change must keep working
findings: PalletPoseNode::on_pair is the pair interface: message_filters ApproximateTime of sensor_msgs/Image and vision_msgs/Detection2DArray, queue sync_queue_size 10, max interval sync_slop_s 0.10 s. Topics stay the parameters (yaml depth /camera/depth/image_rect, detections /pps/detections). It calls estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once, on the select_detection bbox_xyxy and that candidate's source_index as instance_id. Every other candidate stays out of stage 2.

DetectionCandidate.source_index is the index in Detection2DArray.detections, not the filtered-list slot. extract_detection_candidates skips empty results and a target_class_id mismatch without renumbering. The detector copies the RGB Image header onto the array and publishes score-sorted boxes capped by max_detections (default 10). It does not set Detection2D.id, so source_index is that published slot for this pair, not a track id across the changing scene.

select_detection keeps highest_confidence (score, then area_px) and largest_area (area_px, then score), returns nullopt on an empty list, and throws std::invalid_argument on an unknown strategy. on_pair publishes nothing when nothing is selected, and nothing when depth_image_to_meters throws after a selection. Those returns must stay silent: a WARN there is recorded as failed instead of no_response.

Deferred source indexes belong on diagnostics_topic (default and pallet_pose_cpp.yaml /pps/pallet_pose_diagnostics; diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray; publisher depth 10). mock pipeline_nodes omits diagnostics_topic, so the C++ default must stay that name. Existing statuses stay name pps_pallet_pose_cpp and hardware_id dynamic_handling_ros_v1. A stage-2 failure stays one WARN whose message and failure_reason are the stage-2 reason. A success stays one OK with message pose_estimated and keys chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, and n_face_points. Both already carry input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp.

Diagnostic stamp strings stay stamp_to_string, '<sec>.<nanosec zero-padded to 9>', the same text as build_bag.format_stamp. RGB is det_msg->header.stamp. Depth is that synced depth_msg->header.stamp. DiagnosticArray.header.stamp and PoseStamped.header.stamp stay publish time. PalletPoseStamped keeps those capture times as builtin_interfaces/Time fields input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp.

The only src subscriber of the diagnostics topic is eval_recorder_node. It ignores every status that is not WARN, joins a WARN on the input_rgb_stamp KeyValue against stamp_map.json, and keeps one diag per sample: the last WARN overwrites failure_reason, or status.message if that key is absent. Duplicate keys collapse in that dict. A deferred WARN that reuses this pair's input_rgb_stamp replaces a real failure reason and marks the sample failed when no rich pose arrives. An OK deferred status is invisible to this recorder. _build_record still prefers a rich pose over any diag.

A success still publishes one geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on pose_topic (yaml /pps/pallet_pose; frame_id is the detection frame or camera_rgb_optical_frame) and one PalletPoseStamped on pallet_pose_topic. dataset_replay maps its pose_topic argument (default /pps/pallet_pose_rich) onto pallet_pose_topic and the recorder, not onto PoseStamped. The recorder reads yaw_rad, pose.position, n_face_points, plane_inlier_ratio, and chamfer_cost_m, and joins on input_rgb_stamp. PalletPoseStamped has no source-index field. PoseResult.instance_id and FailureResult.instance_id hold only the chosen source_index and are not published.

The deferred set is the other extract_detection_candidates entries, named by source_index together with that pair's RGB and depth capture stamps. Non-matching classes are not candidates. One selected candidate leaves today's single diagnostic status unchanged. eval_recorder select_best_detection mirrors the same filter and strategy and does not record source_index. target_class_id pallet and detection_selection highest_confidence must stay aligned in pallet_pose_cpp.yaml, pipeline_nodes, and dataset_replay.launch.
